logistics.format: Practical exam with hand-marked written report (passing 70%+, gold coin 90%+); covers Malware Analysis, Threat Hunting, Advanced SIEM, Vulnerability Management; 4 years validity

recommended_certs.rationale: Security Blue Team recommends BTL1 prior to BTL2 although not formally required.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced professional: 3. The ordered median is professional. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Advanced hunting, malware and SIEM tasks with a hand-marked report support professional analyst delivery at two years; recent uptake and limited external recognition constrain expert standing.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Advanced SIEM, hunting and malware work assessed through a practical and hand-marked report supports professional blue-team delivery. The two-year profile and limited uptake do not establish expert response leadership despite technical depth.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded practical across malware, hunting and advanced SIEM includes a hand-marked written report. That delivery evidence supports professional analysis despite a two-year profile and limited market uptake.
